caption:
🏛️ UNESCO World Heritage sites, country by country — 1978 → 2026.

Italy 62, China 61: a one-site race. China only joined the list in 1987, starting from zero. Watch Europe dominate the early lists, Spain lead in 2002, and China add a site or two every session until it's right behind Italy.

📊 Data: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, via the UNESCO DataHub. A transboundary site counts for each of its countries; no session was held in 2020 and 2022.
